title: Media catalog
description: The catalog of one campaign's APPROVED media, archived by the brandLaunch agent's Campaign Studio plugin (protoLabsAI/campaign-plugin). The files themselves are GitHub release assets on this repo (release tag 'media/<slug>'), never committed to git; this file is the committed index. Append/update only: one entry per approved asset, upserted by its sha256 (the content identity, so two agent instances sharing a slug never overwrite each other). Owner of writes: the campaign plugin, through a PR per batch.

slug.description: The campaign's archive slug — the file name and the release tag suffix. Pinned at first archive, so a renamed campaign keeps its slug.

id.description: The campaign's id in the agent's own campaign database.

release_tag.description: The release holding this campaign's files: 'media/<slug>'. Never marked latest; not a software release.

assets.description: One entry per approved asset, sorted by id.

id.description: The asset's id in the agent's campaign database (stable for the asset's life; a copy into another campaign gets a new id).

lane.description: The lane (message) the asset belongs to; '' when none.

duration_s.description: Seconds; 0 for a still or card.

sha256.description: The file's SHA-256 — the archive's identity: the same bytes are uploaded once.

approved_at.description: When the operator approved it (ISO-8601 UTC).

review_note.description: The operator's note at approval ('' when none).

url.description: The release asset's download URL (needs repo access — the repo is private).

release_tag.description: The release the file lives on — usually this campaign's, or the campaign it was first archived from for a collected copy.

archived_at.description: When the file was uploaded (ISO-8601 UTC).
